mainImage.alt: Aerial view of a massive fire engulfing the Medline Industries warehouse in Tracy, California on June 11, 2026. Thick black smoke rises from the burning facility.
mainImage.caption: Black smoke pours from the Medline Industries medical supply warehouse in Tracy, California on June 11, 2026. The 1-million-square-foot facility was fully consumed within 40 minutes.

body.alt: Helicopter aerial view showing a massive warehouse fire at the Medline Industries distribution center with thick black smoke billowing across the sky in Tracy, California.
body.caption: LiveCopter footage shows the scale of the Medline warehouse fire, with black smoke visible for miles across California's Central Valley.
body.credit: KPIX/CBS News Bay Area via KCRA 3

body.alt: A massive plume of black smoke rises from the Medline warehouse fire, visible across the Tracy, California skyline as the fire continues to burn.
body.caption: The smoke plume from the Medline fire remained visible for days, raising air quality concerns for communities across San Joaquin County.
